[[Gallatin, Tennessee]] }} '''John Logan Jenkins''' (born March 6, 1991http://vucommodores.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/jenkins_john00.html in Hendersonville, Tennessee), is an American basketball player who played at [[Vanderbilt University]] in Nashville from 2009 through 2012. He is a 6-foot-4, 215-pound shooting guard. He was a two-time TSSAA Class AA Mr. Basketball selection, and was the Gatorade Tennessee High School Player of the Year in 2008-09.http://pittsburgh.rivals.com/content.asp?CID=948141 He is the most highly touted recruit ever to sign with [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores Men's Basketball]]. As a senior at Gallatin (Tenn.) Station Camp, Jenkins was the nation's leading scorer for high schoolers averaging 42.3 points and scoring at least 30 in every game.http://www.digitalsports.com/article/id/59962.aspx As a sophomore was picked to the Fifth Team All-America by [[Fox Sports (United States)|Fox Sports]].{{cite news|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|url=http://msn.foxsports.com/collegebasketball/story/duke-blue-devils-notre-dame-fighting-irish-represented-postseason-honors-030711|title=Goodman's 2010-11 All-America teams|work=[[Fox Sports (United States)|Fox Sports]]|publisher=Fox Sports Interactive Media|date=Mar 7, 2011|accessdate=June 21, 2011}} On April 9, 2012, he announced that he would forego his final year of eligibility at Vanderbilt to enter the [[2012 NBA Draft]].{{cite web|url=http://www.usatoday.com/sports/college/mensbasketball/story/2012-04-09/john-jenkins-vanderbilt-nba/54135998/1|title=John Jenkins leaving Vanderbilt a year early for NBA|accessdate=April 9, 2012|date=April 9, 2012|publisher=''USAToday.com''|author=Associated Press}} The [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]] deadline for players to withdraw from the draft and retain college eligibility passed the following day; as Jenkins did not choose to withdraw, his college eligibility ended at that time. ==Awards and honors== *The Tennessean Boys Player of the Year in 2008 and 2009 *PARADE All-American and Reebok All-American in his senior year.http://www.tennessean.com/section/SPECIAL0221 *2012 [[Associated Press]] Third Team All-American ==References== {{reflist}} {{Persondata | NAME = Jenkins, John | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = March 6, 1991 | PLACE OF BIRTH = | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Jenkins, John}} [[Category:1991 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Tennessee]] [[Category:Parade High School All-Americans (boys' basketball)]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Sumner County, Tennessee]] [[de:John Jenkins (Basketballspieler)]]
